map.买房核面积时，用套内面积除以（1−公摊系数）反推建筑面积，验证合同标注是否一致，: When checking the area before buying, divide the internal area by (1 - shared area coefficient) to back out the gross floor area and check whether the contract figures match, avoiding an inflated shared area.
map.公摊系数一般多少？: What is a typical shared area coefficient?
map.多层住宅约 10%–15%，高层约 18%–25%，写字楼/商业更高。具体以楼盘: Multi-storey housing is about 10%-15%, high-rise about 18%-25%, and offices or commercial buildings higher. The property survey figures govern; this tool uses the coefficient you enter.
map.封闭阳台通常算全面积，未封闭阳台多数地区按半面积；具体以当地房产测绘规则为准，本: A closed balcony is normally counted at full area, while an unclosed balcony counts at half area in most regions. Local property survey rules govern, and this tool computes by the rule you select.
map.建筑面积计算器，支持公摊面积、套内面积与得房率计算及多种房间形状，辅助购房与户型: Floor area calculator supporting shared area, internal area and usable area ratio calculations across many room shapes, assisting with home purchase and layout assessment.
map.本工具为估算。若差异较大，以有资质测绘机构出具的房屋面积测绘报告为确权依据。: This tool gives an estimate. If the difference is large, the area survey report issued by a qualified surveying institution is the basis for establishing the area.
map.算出来和产证不符怎么办？: What if the result does not match the certificate of origin?
map.自建房或商铺报建，按外墙中线、阳台半面积等规则汇总各层面积，初估总建筑面积用于费: For self-built houses or shop units, sum the area of each floor by rules such as the exterior wall centerline and half the balcony area, then pre-estimate the total floor area for cost and floor area ratio checks.
map.装修预算按建筑面积或套内面积计价时，先算清两种口径差额，防止按错基数导致报价偏差: When a renovation budget is priced by gross floor area or by interior usable area, first compute the gap between the two bases so that using the wrong base does not distort the quote.
